_comment: The documents FinSight is measured on. Source files are read where they
live and are never copied or modified; a path outside the repository is
expected and fine. Documents carrying a `truth` file are the regression
gate. The rest measure behaviour on shapes the keyed set does not cover,
and their fact counts are evidence about the pipeline, not about accuracy.

documents.kind: the same release with its text layer removed
documents.notes: Proves the visual-only path reaches the same answers as the text one.
The floor: skew, noise and contrast loss on top of the image-only case.
A 52/53-week fiscal calendar, which is why period dates are persisted rather than recomputed.
The visual-layout case: figures arranged rather than tabulated.
The size case. Slow enough that it is measured once per phase, not per change.
Its own text layer is OCR output and carries errors ('We undersland your world'), so the visual path is not merely an alternative here.
States its own unit conversion on the page: 'Rs 1 Cr = Rs 10 million'.
Filed under the legal name 'Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited', which no metric taxonomy would recognise as Groww.
